story_zh: 王博士研究太空材料。他的飞船通过地球大气层降落。他使用技术测量空气温度和速度。同时，他翻译外星语言，学习语法和知识。密码保护信息，数字显示数量。相反的特点有相同的效果。他的专业是科学，需要力气工作。
story_pinyin: Wáng bóshì yánjiū tàikōng cáiliào. Tā de fēichuán tōngguò dìqiú dàqìcéng jiàngluò. Tā shǐyòng jìshù cèliáng kōngqì wēndù hé sùdù. Tóngshí, tā fānyì wàixīng yǔyán, xuéxí yǔfǎ hé zhīshì. Mìmǎ bǎohù xìnxī, shùzì xiǎnshì shùliàng. Xiāngfǎn de tèdiǎn yǒu xiāngtóng de xiàoguǒ. Tā de zhuānyè shì kēxué, xūyào lìqi gōngzuò.
story_en: Dr. Wang researches space materials. His spaceship lands through Earth's atmosphere. He uses technology to measure air temperature and speed. At the same time, he translates alien languages, learning grammar and knowledge. Passwords protect information, numbers show quantity. Opposite features have the same effect. His major is science, requiring strength to work.
